purpose: Make Mixture-of-Experts VRAM planning explicit without reusing the dense LLM formula incorrectly.

moeEstimatePolicy.description: Estimate MoE resident weight memory from source-backed total parameters, then add MoE-adjusted context and runtime overhead before applying a safety margin.
moeEstimatePolicy.formula: weightMemoryGb = (residentParameterCountB * bitsPerParameter / 8) * weightOverheadMultiplier; estimatedCoreGb = weightMemoryGb + (contextOverheadGb * moeContextMultiplier) + (runtimeOverheadGb * moeRuntimeMultiplier); estimatedVramGb = estimatedCoreGb * (1 + safetyMarginPercent / 100)
moeEstimatePolicy.warning: MoE planning only. Total parameters are used as the conservative resident weight-memory baseline. Active parameters explain per-token compute behavior, not minimum VRAM.
moeEstimatePolicy.residentWeightPolicy: Use source-backed total parameters as the default resident weight baseline. If a source-backed packaged parameter count is higher, use it as the conservative baseline and label the result clearly.

quantizationProfiles.label: FP16/BF16
quantizationProfiles.notes: Planning profile only; actual MoE deployment can shard or offload weights.

quantizationProfiles.label: 8-bit
quantizationProfiles.notes: Implementation-specific weight and scale overheads can vary.

quantizationProfiles.label: 4-bit / Q4 planning profile
quantizationProfiles.notes: GGUF, GPTQ, AWQ, and runtime-specific MoE quantization can differ.

contextPresets.label: Medium context
contextPresets.notes: KV cache and attention implementation can materially change memory use.

contextPresets.label: Large context
contextPresets.notes: Large context planning should be validated on the exact runtime.

runtimeProfiles.label: llama.cpp / GGUF planning
runtimeProfiles.notes: Local runtime behavior depends on quantization, offload, and backend support.

runtimeProfiles.label: Ollama planning
runtimeProfiles.notes: Ollama memory behavior depends on its model package and backend.

runtimeProfiles.label: vLLM serving planning
runtimeProfiles.notes: Serving workloads can allocate additional memory for KV cache, batching, and parallelism.

runtimeProfiles.label: Transformers planning
runtimeProfiles.notes: Device map, dtype, offload, attention implementation, and trust-remote-code behavior can change memory use.

gpuSuggestionPolicy.draftGpuLabel: Planning-only candidate; verify specs and runtime behavior before hardware decisions.
